page.layout: One column of index entries, letter headings M., N., O., P. in the left margin position, catchword "Pole-" at lower right.
page.notes: Section letters M., N., O., P. are set as large initials; the N entry "Abis" is read from a large initial and is doubtful ("Abis[?]"). The entry Φιδίτια is doubtful in its Greek letters. The initial of "Ostracismus" may be a Greek omicron; it is copied as printed in Latin letters. No page number is printed. Running head "INDEX" is set in spaced capitals. Printed lines are kept as separate lines; hyphens at line ends are kept as printed.
